Shopping for Souvenirs

100Ls Shadowing Material · Lesson M2-04  ·  ← 上一课
📄 Full Script — Dialogue
0:00 / 0:00
速度：
Staff
Hi there! Can I help you find anything today?
Ryan
Yes, I'm looking for a gift for my parents back home — something local, if possible.
Staff
These hand-painted mugs are really popular. Or if you want something smaller, we have magnets and keychains.
Ryan
Those mugs look great. How much are they?
Staff
Twenty-five dollars each, or three for sixty.
Ryan
I'll take three. Do you do gift wrapping?
Staff
Absolutely, free of charge! Cash or card?
Ryan
Card, please.
Staff
Perfect. Enjoy the rest of your trip!
Staff：您好！今天需要帮您找什么吗？
Ryan：是的，我想给国内的父母带个礼物——如果可以的话，最好是当地特色的。
Staff：这些手绘马克杯很受欢迎。或者如果您想要小一点的，我们有磁贴和钥匙扣。
Ryan：那些马克杯看起来不错。多少钱？
Staff：每个25美元，或者三个60美元。
Ryan：我要三个。你们提供礼品包装吗？
Staff：当然，免费的！现金还是刷卡？
Ryan：刷卡。
Staff：好的。祝您旅途愉快！

🔗 Connected Speech
"can I help you"
/kənaɪhelpjʊ/
Reduction+Linking
"can" weakens to /kən/; help+you link naturally.
"free of charge"
/friːəvtʃɑːrdʒ/
Reduction
"of" weakens to /əv/ in unstressed position.
"three for sixty"
/θriːfər ˈsɪksti/
Reduction
"for" weakens to /fər/; stress falls on "sixty".
"do you do"
/djʊduː/
Yod Coalescence
First "do you" merges; /d/ + /j/ → /dʒ/.
"rest of your"
/restəvjə/
Reduction
"of" → /əv/, "your" → /jə/ in fast speech.
